newsitem.title: JAPAN: Okasan Sec chairman to become JSDA acting chairman.
newsitem.headline: Okasan Sec chairman to become JSDA acting chairman.

text.p: The Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Wednesday that Okasan Securities Co Ltd chairman Seiichi Kato will become acting chairman of the industry body.
The association did not specify for how long Kato would serve as acting head.
On Friday, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd chairman Tsugio Yukihira resigned as JSDA head due to his company's involvement in a high-profile payoff scandal.
On July 30, prosecutors and officials of the Securities and Exchange and Surveillance Commission raided the offices of Yamaichi looking for evidence of an alleged payoff to a "sokaiya" racketeer.
